name: asic-tools
description: Agent-harness tooling for Claude Code. PRP lifecycle: idea-refine (upstream ideation one-pager), prp-draft (research-first PRP generator), prp-review (adversarial tier-sized review gate), and prp-implement (two-phase drift-checked executor). Plus asicdash (config + usage dashboard: audit visible and invisible config, Claude usage heatmap), scaffold (standards-enforced Python bootstrap), release (multi-location version bump + changelog), and sync-rules (deploy the bundled global engineering rules to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and merge the guardrail settings into ~/.claude/settings.json). Plus diagram (draw.io architecture/network/system diagram generator: NL→diagram, code-to-diagram, CLI export). Plus improve-repo (repo-wide standards-conformance auditor: audits version/scaffold/import/naming drift, ships category-scoped fix PRs). Plus okf (Open Knowledge Format: vendored spec, offline conformance validator, index generator for agent-readable knowledge bundles).
